speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the results; the normal inflammatory markers and cardiac enzymes make an active infection or acute myocardial infarction less likely. Also, does your cough worsen significantly when you lie flat?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't noticed any swelling in my ankles or a feeling of fluid in my lungs. My cough does seem to get a bit worse when I lie flat, which makes it harder to sleep through the night. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure (Left Ventricular Dysfunction) with secondary chronic bronchitis symptoms due to pulmonary congestion from reduced cardiac output. The confirmed wall motion abnormalities and orthopnea, despite normal inflammatory markers, strongly indicate cardiogenic pulmonary edema as the primary cause of your cough.
